You are asked to rescue an Imperial Guardsman kidnapped by the [[Am Fah]]. 

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find the kidnapped guard in [[Wajjun Bazaar]].
* Kill the Am Fah guarding the captive.
* See [[Emperor's Hand]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest is straight-forward. Entering from either [[The Marketplace]] or [[Nahpui Quarter]], make your way to the area just past the entrance to [[The Undercity]]. A large group of hostile Am Fah guard the guardsman. Take them out and the quest is complete.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]] ([[Imperial Guard]])
* {{x}} 20 [[Imperial Guardsman Hanzing]]

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Emperor's Hand'''
:''"The Am Fah have kidnapped an Imperial Guardsman and taken him to '''Wajjun Bazaar'''. We cannot allow such a crime to go unpunished. An assault on one of the emperor's guardsman is an assault on the emperor himself!

:''"Will you rescue '''[[Imperial Guardsman Hanzing]]'''?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = He is as good as found.
|decline = He is as good as dead.
|ask = Imperial Guardsman Hanzing is being detained in Wajjun Bazaar. Rescue him with haste. 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
''When you approach Imperial Guardsman Hanzing''
:'''Imperial Guardsman Hanzing:''' ''"Thank goodness you came. I was beginning to lose faith."''

''After defeating surrounding Am Fah''
:'''Imperial Guardsman Hanzing:''' ''"I am in your debt. Let's get out of here before more of the Am Fah come!"''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Emperor's Hand'''
:''"You have served your Emperor well. Thank you for your service."''

==Notes==
*You can still complete this quest even if [[It Ends Here]] is active in your quest log.
*Even with [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] active in your quest log, the Am Fah surrounding the guard will be hostile.

==Trivia==
*Once released from his captivity, Imperial Guardsman Hanzing walks to the nearest entrance to The Undercity.
